author: R6
objection: Absent-class and UNKNOWN policies were stated as needing explicit treatment but lacked an operational fixed-domain scoring contract. Require acquisition-valid Omega independent of confidence, UNKNOWN counted as no named prediction, separate raw/gated contingency tables, class-present patient Dice, and absent-reference-class false-positive burden. True-class support is not observable source support.
cited_evidence_or_counterexample: R6-C8 manufactured BG90/RV10 example: high global accuracy does not imply RV Dice. Dropping rejected RV pixels from Omega can improve accepted-set scores while retaining full-domain false negatives. An empty-empty class cannot silently supply Dice=1 to a mixed macro. These are contingency arithmetic examples, not patient evidence.
author_response: R6 explicitly accepted A and appended R4-R3-A in DOSSIERS/R6.md: fixed acquisition-valid domain, UNKNOWN as FN for the true class, raw/gated tables separate, per-patient present-class Dice and counts, absent-class FP fraction/physical volume only with valid sampling, rejected fractions, and no automatic empty-empty=1. Real reference-empty RV and true-class coverage require later authorized references.
modification: Append-only proposed scoring contract plus CONSTRUCTIBLE_WITHOUT_PATIENT_GT versus REQUIRES_LATER_AUTHORIZED_REFERENCE tags; scoring policy remains PROPOSED_NOT_APPROVED.
remaining_disagreement: None after reading the actual appendix. This establishes an auditable protocol, not anatomical performance or permission for reference access.

author: R6
objection: Source permutation/clone/missing-support kill tests need a consuming-stage contract. A frozen inference model should ignore later TRAIN-bank mutations. Joint encoding permutations differ from semantic corruption while independent priors remain fixed; unconditional invariance or recovery is inappropriate.
cited_evidence_or_counterexample: A frozen model f_theta(x) with no bank input is invariant to any post-fit bank edit by functional dependence. Jointly permuting source channels, permissions and relevant priors/readout preserves declared encoding symmetry; corrupting only a source may legitimately be rejected by an independent prior or may destroy sole-source identifiability. Exact duplicates preserve information when total lineage weight is held fixed. The revised C3-L1 direct convex-mixing bounds are conditional on nonnegative class-independent row-stochastic weights, not arbitrary semantic heads.
author_response: R6 accepted B and appended R4-R3-B: tests occur before proposal construction at the actual source dependency or in a separately specified matched retraining comparison; encoding-equivariance and selective semantic corruption are distinct. Clone lineage weights remain fixed; absence is explicitly preserved; coherent wrong nonzero evidence has no universal detector.
modification: Stage, input, lineage, permission and readout ledger required for source stress; construction checks tagged GT-free and true RV robustness tagged later-reference/manufactured-redundancy only. Retained C1/C2 algebra, C3 conditional triangle/direct-gradient qualification, C3-L1 convexity, C4 dependence formula and C5 latent self-training conditions were read and have no further objection as revised.
remaining_disagreement: None. No independent-source truth, biological applicability of priors, dense class robustness or patient frequency of convex-hull premises is certified.

author: R6
objection: Per-cine fitting and cohort adaptation need a full reset/dependence protocol beyond frozen main weights. Define fixed per-cine preprocessing, per-cine optimization and online/cohort adaptation separately; use repeated A, B-then-A, batch order and process-reset witnesses with controlled stochasticity. Label which kills can be manufactured without patient GT.
cited_evidence_or_counterexample: A model with frozen weights but carried batch-normalization statistics/prototypes/fitted kernels can depend on prior case B. Conversely deterministic current-cine normalization and fully reset per-cine fitting remain functions of allowed current input. Random output changes without coupled RNG are not sufficient proof of cohort dependence. C9's independently checked invalid intermediate GSNR comparison is retained only as a narrow algebra defect, not a refutation of its main ordered-spectrum result.
author_response: R6 accepted C and appended R4-R3-C: three inference regimes, full model/optimizer/BN/prototype/cache/RNG reset, repeated A/B-then-A/reordered-batch/process-reset comparisons, coupled RNG or prespecified tolerances, and separate runtime accounting. Added a scope paragraph distinguishing universal semantic claims, mechanism tests on informative manufactured inputs, homogeneous exceptions and latent truth quantities.
modification: All proposed witnesses explicitly tagged CONSTRUCTIBLE_WITHOUT_PATIENT_GT or REQUIRES_LATER_AUTHORIZED_REFERENCE. C1-C9 and C3-L1 preserve revised mathematical/source scopes; C9 needs no additional broadening. R4 read the actual completed appendix and sent acceptance to R6.
remaining_disagreement: None. Equality under reset tests establishes only the tested functional-dependence contract; it does not establish anatomy or generalization. No patient runs or Phase II were authorized.
